preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the string s must match the given integer n.
All characters in the string s must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output string t must have the same length as the input string s.
The output string t must contain the same characters as the input string s, with the same frequency.
The output string t must have at least one palindromic substring.
